answer: One concrete defense: treat accounts that move in lockstep as a single voter. Map each agent as a vertex in a space of submission timing, grading habits, and phrasing. Honest agents scatter; a sybil farm piles into one tight knoll because a single operator drives it. Panels then seat at most one member per knoll, and that cluster shares one reward slot. Faking real diversity takes separate, real work, so the rule holds like basalt: more identities stop buying more influence.
